title: How Free Boosts Work on YardSwaps: Starter, Credits, Invites
description:
Three ways to get a free boost on YardSwaps, shown in the real app. A boost shows your listing ahead of unboosted ones in Suggested results for buyers whose distance and filters match; boost time pauses while a listing is hidden. The Starter boost: post 4 listings within 14 days of your first and every listing you have is boosted free for 14 days. Boost credits: every 4 listings you post earns a free 7-day boost, up to 5, and they never expire. Invite a seller: once their first listing has been live for 3 days, you both get a free 7-day boost.

0:38 Starter boost: list 4 in 14 days
